title: Amorph
description: Six Beatles album covers printed in tens of thousands of dots of ink. Every few seconds, or wherever you click, the next cover ripples out across the print: a wavefront travels at a steady speed, and as it reaches each dot a spring swells it, nudges it outward and settles it into its new colour. Click again mid-ripple and the new wave rides on top of the old one.
intent: Real motion instead of eases: every dot's change is a critically damped spring and its push is a spring driving a spring, solved exactly per dot on the GPU, so nothing runs linear, nothing overshoots, and overlapping ripples add together without a jump.
